text: The Yoneda lemma identifies the natural transformations Nat(Hom(A, −), F), for F: 𝒞 → Set, with:
choices: the set of objects of 𝒞
explanation: A natural transformation η is determined by the single element η_A(id_A) ∈ F(A), and every element arises this way. Consequence: the Yoneda embedding A ↦ Hom(A, −) is fully faithful — an object is determined by the maps out of (or into) it.
